prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-fashion 1:1 Nike tennis sports editorial campaign. Show a confident adult female tennis athlete with a curvy feminine silhouette, natural skin texture, ponytail, and focused direct gaze, seated casually on a professional green tennis court. She wears a fitted white Nike performance crop top with a flattering neckline, crisp white pleated tennis skirt, white visor, wristbands, socks, and Nike tennis shoes. Pose her with one knee raised, one leg extended, one hand near the knee, and the other supporting her body; place a tennis racket beside her. Add giant white PRECISION typography behind her with accurate smaller copy FOCUS. CONTROL. CONFIDENCE. and a Nike swoosh. Use soft natural sunlight, realistic shadows enhancing the fitted silhouette, subtle sweat sheen, crisp court lines, and no watermark or extra text.
